$schema: Samidha Reviews design tokens - single source of truth for color, type, spacing, radii. Applied to site/ (static marketing+docs), web/ (React dashboard), and (forward-looking) the HF model card once Wave 3 publishes weights. Every color pair listed under contrastPairs is WCAG-AA-verified by scripts/check_contrast.py, which runs in CI.
concept: Samidha (समिधा) - wood offered to a sacred fire. The mark is two flame shapes, tilted toward and away from each other, on a cream ground: a review comes in raw, and leaves as one clear, structured signal. Session 13: replaces the provisional four-crossed-sticks brown-gradient mark recovered from a lost branch with GG's approved final saffron/ember mark.

derived._note: Solid tints of the four brand colors (alpha-composited, so a contrast check can run on a real hex). Used by web/ dashboard for secondary text, surfaces, rules and chip backgrounds. Not new hues: every value is ink, cream, saffron or ember mixed with cream or ink. web/tailwind.config.js mirrors these and web/src/lib/tokens.test.ts fails if the two drift.

usageRules: Dark surfaces (marketing hero, dashboard dark mode): background ink, body text cream, links/accent saffron or ember (both pass AA on ink).
Light surfaces (docs, dashboard light mode): background cream, body text ink (NOT saffron or ember - both fail AA on cream, see contrastPairs).
Buttons with a saffron or ember background use ink text, never white/cream text (fails AA - see knownFailingPairs).
saffron and ember are for the mark and accents/buttons only - never as a body-text or link color on a light/cream background.

knownFailingPairs.name: saffron-bg-white-text
knownFailingPairs.rule: Never use white/cream text on a saffron background - use ink instead (see usageRules).

knownFailingPairs.name: ember-bg-white-text
knownFailingPairs.rule: Never use white/cream text on an ember background - use ink instead (see usageRules).

knownFailingPairs.name: light-bg-saffron-text
knownFailingPairs.rule: Never use raw saffron as text/link color on a light/cream background - use ink instead.

knownFailingPairs.name: light-bg-ember-text
knownFailingPairs.rule: Never use raw ember as text/link color on a light/cream background - use ink instead.

display.role: Headlines, hero text - carries the warmth/craft of the brand.

mono.role: Code, JSON output, review IDs - pairs natively with IBM Plex Sans.
